layoutProfile.name: wide-desktop-contextual-reference
layoutProfile.description: Renderer-oriented Access 2021 ribbon model with permanent tabs and object/view-specific contextual ribbon sets.

coordinateSystem.rowMeaning: Small controls occupy logical rows; large controls generally span all three rows.
coordinateSystem.columnMeaning: Logical position within a ribbon group, not pixel coordinates.

contextBehavior.selectionRule: Render baseTabs plus the tabs from the first contextualRibbonSet whose activation rule matches the active object and view.

layoutProfile.importantNote: This is not an official Microsoft full-ribbon XML export. Access contextual tabs vary by object type, view, selected control, database state, Office build and enabled features. Candidate idMso values should be validated against the user's Access 2021 installation.

controls.label: View
controls.notes: Changes available views depending on active Access object
